Where is Iris? Ull showed up and seems to have taken her away... What on earth is going on?
I'll discuss that with you later. For now, I'll tell you only what you need to know.
Iris is under our protection, but...
strings.불완전한 각성 때문에 벌어지는 일에 대해선 저희 연합도 어느 정도 책임이: We believe the Alliance bears some responsibility for what her incomplete awakening has caused.
strings.그래서 수련의 숲에서 일어난 일들을 수습 중입니다. 이리스 님 관련 이야: That is why we're dealing with the aftermath of what happened in the Training Forest. We'll discuss Iris later, so please be patient a little longer...
strings.(조금만이라면 대체…. 말을 피하고 있어….): (How much longer is 'a little'? She's avoiding the subject...)
strings.얼마 전에 쥬드 왕국 서쪽에 있는 아말룬 사막에서 거대한 모래바람이 불어: Not long ago, an enormous sandstorm swept through the Amaloon Desert, west of the Kingdom of Jude.
strings.일반적인 모래바람이 아니라서 드리는 말씀입니다. 마력이 가득 담겨 있던: I'm telling you because it was no ordinary sandstorm. It was filled with magic, and it transformed the Amaloon Desert.
strings.사막이 어떻게 변한 건가요?: How did it change the desert?
strings.원래 아말룬 사막은 '무의 사막'이라 불릴 정도로 척박한 정도가 엄청나: The Amaloon Desert was so barren that it was known as the 'Desert of Nothingness.' Nothing could live there.
strings.그래서 사람들과 동물을 비롯해 몬스터들도 접근조차 잘 하지 않는 그런 곳: People and animals hardly ever ventured near it. Even monsters stayed away.
strings.그런 곳에 마력이 가득 담긴 모래바람이 왔다 가면서 이스트랜드의 것이라: But after that magic-laden sandstorm passed through, strange castles and buildings appeared—nothing that could have come from Eastland...
And people and strange creatures emerged from them. Beings from another world...
It's a minor detail. I don't think it warrants a separate explanation.
strings.(뭔가 있을 것 같은데, 나중에 좀 알아봐야겠어.): (I feel like there's more to this. I'll have to look into it later.)
All right, I'll go take a look.
strings.(유란이 루맨 연합 본부를 빠져나가는 %s의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라본다.): (Yuran stares intently at %s's back as they leave the Lumen Alliance Headquarters.)
There were more monsters than I expected.
strings.%s 님보다 먼저 사막을 다녀온 길드 요원들이 쫓기듯이 돌아온 것도 이해: Now I understand why the guild agents who went to the desert before you, %s, came back as though something were chasing them.
We keep finding ourselves in situations like this.
strings.그렇게 놀라실 필요 없습니다. 의외로 %s 님 표정에서 쉽게 알아차릴 수: There's no need to look so surprised. Your expressions are surprisingly easy to read, %s.
strings.아, 마침 사막을 다녀온 길드 요원 중 하나가 깨어나 이야기를 나눴습니다: Oh, one of the guild agents who returned from the desert has just regained consciousness. I spoke with them.
strings.사막 중심에 전에 없었던 오아시스가 있었고, 이세계의 옷을 입고 있는 여: Apparently, an oasis appeared in the middle of the desert where there had never been one before. They also saw a woman dressed in clothes from another world.
strings.어떤 사람인가요?: What kind of person is she?
strings.사막에 나타난 몬스터들에게 쫓겨 거기까진 알 수 없었습니다. 아무래도 모: They couldn't find out. The monsters that appeared in the desert drove them away. I'm afraid you'll have to investigate that yourself...
Sigh... Of course. I wasn't really expecting much anyway...
strings.저희 연합은 기본적으로 일이 많습니다. 인근 쥬드 왕국의 복구를 돕는 일: The Alliance has a great deal to do as it is. We're helping rebuild the neighboring Kingdom of Jude, dealing with the Deimos cult as it spreads evil...
You want me to lend a hand.
Consider this an official request from the Alliance.
strings.쥬얼 학파 마법사들에게 안전을 위해 쥬드 왕국과 루맨으로 들어오는 길에: For safety, I've ordered the Jewel School mages to set up protective barriers on the roads into the Kingdom of Jude and Lumen.
All you need to do is deal with the situation in the Amaloon Desert, outside the barrier.
strings.제가 혼자서 해결까지 다 하고 와야 하나요?: Do I have to resolve the whole thing on my own?
strings.네, 아무래도 %s 님이 적임자라고 생각합니다. 이리스 님을 돕는 사람이: Yes. I believe you are the right person for the job, %s. Naturally, someone helping Iris should take on her work.
strings.…틀린 말은 아니지만, 저 혼자 하기는 너무 많지 않나요?: ...You're not wrong, but isn't that a little much for one person?
strings.서쪽으로 쭉 가면 지하 도시 타르타로스가 나옵니다만, 거기까진 가시지 않: If you keep heading west, you'll reach the underground city of Tartaros, but you needn't go that far.
strings.그럼 이번에도 부탁드립니다. 이왕이면 마무리까지 다 하시고 돌아오셨으면: Then I'll leave it to you again. Preferably, you'll have everything wrapped up by the time you return.
strings.(일단 가는 수밖에 없겠어.): (I suppose I have no choice but to go.)
What do you mean? We've never met...
Please don't be alarmed. I'm not a bad person.
strings.제 소개를 할게요. 제 이름은 티야. 저기 보이는 황금 성의 주인이셨던: Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Tia. I am the daughter of the late pharaoh, who ruled the golden castle you see over there.
strings.경계하실 필요는 없어요. 저는 적이 아니에요. 오히려 제가 도움을 요청하: You needn't be wary of me. I'm not your enemy. In fact, I want to ask for your help.
I don't sense any hostility, but...
strings.그럼 이렇게 하면 믿어주실 수 있으신가요? 이건 당신의 세계엔 없는 물건: Would this help you trust me? This is something you won't find in your world. Please, take it.
strings.(티야가 금으로 된 장식품을 손에 건네준다.): (Tia places a gold ornament in your hand.)
strings.이런 걸 주셔도 괜찮아요?: Are you sure you can give this away?
strings.이런 건 어떨까요? 제 이야길 들어주신다면 필요한 걸 더 드릴 수도 있는: How about this? If you'll hear me out, I can give you more of whatever you need...
I'll trust you. So please keep what you were going to give me.
strings.(티야가 손에 쥐어주던 금 장식품을 돌려준다.): (You return the gold ornament Tia placed in your hand.)
Oh, right. The reason I came here is...
strings.(티야에게 이곳까지 오게 된 이유를 간단하게 설명한다.): (You briefly explain to Tia why you've come.)
Then I'll tell you how I came to be here, too.
strings.선대 파라오셨던 아버지께서 돌아가신 후, 형제들은 서로 왕좌에 오르기 위: After my father, the previous pharaoh, passed away, my siblings fought each other for the throne.
strings.제일 힘도 없고 세력도 없었던 저와 제 동생은 그저 이 지옥 같은 나날들: My younger brother and I had neither power nor supporters. We could only pray for those hellish days to end...
strings.오빠와 언니들은 그러지 않았어요. 짐이 된다고 생각했는지 모두 죽이려고: But our older brothers and sisters felt differently. They must have thought us a burden, because they tried to kill us all.
strings.그 과정에서 동생은 모두에게 환멸을 느꼈고, 절대 해서는 안 되는 일에: In the midst of it, my younger brother became disgusted with everyone and did something he should never have done.
strings.죽은 자들의 신과의 계약. 어둠의 힘에 지배당한 동생은 형제를 모두 죽이: He made a pact with the god of the dead. Consumed by dark power, he killed all our siblings... But he couldn't bring himself to kill me, and gave me time to escape.
The next day, he crowned himself king. I haven't seen him since. If only that were the end of it...
The dark power of the god of the dead began to engulf the kingdom.
So that's what happened. Oh, hold on a moment.
strings.이야기를 더 듣고 싶은데…. 근처에 있는 몬스터들이 방해하네요. 금방 처: I'd like to hear more, but... the monsters nearby are getting in the way. I'll deal with them quickly.
strings.그럼 하던 이야기를 이어 할까요?: Shall we pick up where we left off?
strings.네. 이후 저는 성 밖에서 동생을 되돌리고 나라도 구할 수 있는 방법을: Yes. After that, I stayed outside the castle, searching for a way to restore my brother and save the kingdom.
I'm ashamed to say I still haven't found one.
strings.그런데 어느 날, 갑자기 마력이 담긴 거센 모래바람이 저희 왕국을 덮치고: Then one day, a violent sandstorm filled with magic suddenly swept over our kingdom...
And that's how you ended up here.
strings.여기 오면서 더 큰 문제가 생겼어요. 이 대륙에 걸쳐져 있는 어둠. 그: But coming here created an even greater problem. The darkness that hangs over this continent... an evil more cruel than anything I've ever known...
strings.성으로 들어가면서 자꾸 더 큰 뭔가를 만들려 하고 있어요…. 도와주세요…: It's entering the castle, trying to create something even greater... Please help us...
strings.이 대륙에 있는 어둠이라면…. 그 말씀을 들으니 확실히 느껴지는 것 같아: The darkness on this continent... Now that you mention it, I think I can feel it. There's an ominous presence here...
You may learn something by examining the monsters nearby.
strings.뭔가 알아오면 봐주실 수 있나요? 제가 티야가 살던 곳에 대한 지식이 하: If I find anything, could you take a look? I don't know anything about the place you came from.
Of course. Thank you. Please take care of yourself.
strings.(티야에게 사막 왕국 라와 함께 온 생명과 싸운 이야기를 한다.): (You tell Tia about fighting the creatures that came here with the desert kingdom of Ra.)
strings.죽은 자들의 신이 가졌던 힘과 이 대륙에 흐르고 있는 어둠의 힘이 서로: It seems the power of the god of the dead and the dark power flowing through this continent have strengthened one another.
They are probably similar kinds of power.
strings.대체 죽은 자들의 신이 뭔가요?: What exactly is this god of the dead?
The being that corrupted my younger brother with dark power. It is more a demon than a god.
strings.사막 왕국 '라'에선 사람이 죽으면 영혼이 빠져나가 갈 곳을 찾아 헤맨다: In the desert kingdom of Ra, we believe that when a person dies, their soul leaves their body and wanders in search of a place to go.
strings.그 영혼이 고통받지 않도록 죽은 자들의 세계로 데려가는 자가 있는데, 그: Someone takes those souls to the world of the dead so they won't suffer. That is the god of the dead.
strings.사람들의 영혼이 길을 잃지 않도록 인도하고 휴식을 취할 수 있도록 돕는…: A guide who keeps human souls from losing their way and helps them find rest...
strings.그런데 왜 신이 아닌 악마라고 부르는 거죠?: Then why do you call him a demon instead of a god?
strings.언젠가 자신을 '죽은 자들의 신'이라고 칭하는 자가 나타났는데, 그가 나: One day, a being calling itself the 'god of the dead' appeared. From then on, an aura of death lingered in the castle.
strings.황금성도 점차 빛을 잃고 사람들이 죽어가면서 파라오께선 그 존재를 찾아: The golden castle gradually lost its luster, and people began to die. So the pharaoh sought out that being, fought it, and won.
strings.그리고 수호자 상에 봉인시켰고, 그 존재를 소환한 자를 처형하셨죠. 다시: He sealed it inside a guardian statue and executed the one who had summoned it, so that demon would never appear again...
strings.하지만, 제 동생이 봉인됐던 죽은 자들의 신을 불러 계약하면서 모든 상황: But my younger brother summoned the imprisoned god of the dead and made a pact with it. Everything took a turn for the worse.
strings.죽은 자들의 신은 목표를 달성했고, 일시적으로 사라졌지만…. 그 후가 문: The god of the dead accomplished its goal and vanished for a time... But what happened afterward was the problem. Sigh...
strings.모험가님, 이 이야길 알리셔야 할 것 같아요. 모험가님이 머문 곳의 마력: Adventurer, I think you should report this. Judging by the magic of the place where you were staying, they should be able to prepare for it to some extent.
Yes, I will. I'll be back.
Since you've come to me, I assume you've learned something serious.
strings.(유란에게 아말룬 사막에서 티야를 만난 이야기를 한다.): (You tell Yuran about meeting Tia in the Amaloon Desert.)
strings.상황은 어느 정도 파악했습니다. 골치가 다 아프군요. 아무래도 경계가 약: I have a fair understanding of the situation now. What a headache. It seems you'll need to start where their defenses are weakest.
strings.흐음, 라의 성곽이란 곳인데…. 혹시 모험가님, 벌레 좋아하십니까?: Hmm, a place called Ra's Fortress... By the way, adventurer, do you like insects?
strings.그곳에 거대한 벌레 괴물이 있다고 하는군요. 보이는 대로 먹어치우고 있다: Apparently, there's an enormous insect monster there. It's devouring everything in sight. At this rate, it may break out.
Even several guild members together don't seem strong enough to handle it.
strings.어쩔 수 없이 모험가님께서 직접 해결해 주셔야겠습니다. 그래야 다른 곳의: I'm afraid you'll have to deal with it yourself. We won't be able to move against the other areas until you do...
strings.(이리스를 위한 일이니 일단 참고 하긴 하겠지만….): (I'll put up with this for Iris's sake, but...)
strings.다녀오시는 걸로 알겠습니다. 최대한 그 이세계의 여성과 협력해 신속하게: I'll take that as your agreement. Work with that woman from the other world and resolve this as quickly as possible. And don't worry about Iris.
strings.(유란이 루맨을 떠나는 %s의 뒷모습을 빤히 바라본다.): (Yuran stares intently at %s's back as they leave Lumen.)
strings.역시 안 되겠군. 아말룬 사막을 비롯해 또 어딘가에 비슷한 일들이 일어났: This won't do after all. Something similar must have happened elsewhere, not just in the Amaloon Desert. I'll have to keep investigating.
strings.감사드려요. 라으나툰이 쓰러지면서 성곽에 있던 '죽은 자들의 신'의 어둠: Thank you. With Raunatun defeated, some of the god of the dead's darkness has vanished from the fortress.
It does feel like some of that foul presence has left the desert.
strings.라으나툰은 오래전부터 라의 주민들에게는 공포의 대상이었어요. 식탐이 강해: The people of Ra had feared Raunatun for ages. Its appetite was so great that it swallowed people and animals whole.
As though that weren't enough, it often came down to attack people's homes. The first pharaoh was deeply troubled by it. He tried to destroy Raunatun, but couldn't finish it off.
strings.그래서 극악무도한 죄인들을 둥지에 바치는 정도로 식탐을 일시적이나마 잠재: So they offered the most heinous criminals to its nest, appeasing its hunger, if only for a while.
strings.나쁜 짓 하면 안 되겠군요. 벌레에게 잡아 먹혀 끝나는 삶이라니…, 생각: That's a good reason to stay out of trouble. To have your life end inside an insect... It's horrifying just to think about.
Adventurer... There's just one thing left to do...
strings.괜찮겠어요?: Will you be all right with this?
strings.동생은 예전의 착하고 순수했던 존재가 아니에요. 어둠에 먹혀 오직 파괴와: My younger brother is no longer the kind, innocent person he once was. Darkness has consumed him. He's become a monster obsessed with power and destruction.
strings.모험가님께서는 마으투를 제 동생이라 생각하지 마시고, 이 세계를 위협하는: Please don't think of Mautu as my brother. Think of him as a monster threatening this world. I beg you.
strings.다시 한 번 물어볼게요. 괜찮으시겠어요?: Let me ask you one more time. Are you sure you'll be all right?
Now that you've returned, adventurer, it must be over.
Yes, I'm all right. I believe my brother would have recognized what he'd done wrong. Thank you... for freeing him from the darkness.
I no longer feel any darkness in the Amaloon Desert. It's all thanks to you.
strings.저는 돌아가려고 해요. 라의 주민들에게 남은 왕족이라고는 저밖에 없으니: I intend to go home. I'm the only member of the royal family the people of Ra have left. I must be there for them.
I'm ashamed that I'm such a powerless princess, with nothing to offer you but words...
But I don't know how to get back.
strings.흐음. 모래바람을 타고 왔으니 다시 타고 가는 건가요?: Hmm. You came on a sandstorm, so perhaps you can ride one back?
That does seem the most likely way.
strings.실력이 뛰어난 마법사라면 방법을 알고 있지 않을까요? 분명 이곳에 불어온: Wouldn't a skilled mage know what to do? Surely someone understands the sandstorm that brought us here...
strings.아, 그렇겠네요! 루맨의 마법사들이 이곳의 모래바람을 확인했다니까 아는: Oh, you're right! The mages in Lumen investigated that sandstorm. They might know something! I'll go ask them!
I'll be right back. Stay here and wait for me.
strings.안녕하세요! 바빠 보이시는데, 무슨 일 있으신가요?: Hello! You seem to be in a hurry. Is something wrong?
(You explain what happened in the Amaloon Desert and ask about the enormous sandstorm.)
strings.아말룬 사막의 모래바람…. 어으, 어떻게 하죠?: The sandstorm in the Amaloon Desert... Oh dear. What should we do?
Nothing's gone wrong exactly, but I don't think another sandstorm will appear in the desert for some time.
strings.그게 사실…. 다른 세계의 어두운 힘과 불완전한 이리스 님의 각성, 그리: Well, the truth is... the dark power from another world, Iris's incomplete awakening, the sinister power of this continent, and so on...
strings.마력이 담긴 모래바람이 불어왔던 건 여러 가지가 합쳐져서 일어난 현상이었: That magic-laden sandstorm was a phenomenon caused by all those things coming together.
strings.혹시나 해서 물어보는 건데, 이리스의 불완전한 각성이 다른 세계에도 영향: Just to be sure... Did Iris's incomplete awakening affect another world, too?
Yes. Even if the effect wasn't very large, I think it did have some influence.
So that's what being a god means...
strings.모래바람 말인데요. 다른 세계의 어두운 힘을 모험가님께서 없애주셨는데,: About the sandstorm... Now that you've destroyed the dark power from the other world, things are rather complicated.
strings.모래바람이 불어오지 못하고 있어요. 누가 막고 있는 게 아니라 그 현상: The sandstorm can't form anymore. No one is blocking it; it seems the phenomenon itself has come to an end.
If Iris becomes a great god, I'm sure she could sort it out in no time.
So Iris is our only answer...
strings.이 일에 대해선 초인들을 비롯해 오래전 암흑 전쟁에서 쥬드 왕국을 지켰던: I think this would be difficult even for an Champion, or for Ixion, the heroic archmage who defended the Kingdom of Jude during the Dark War long ago.
strings.저희쪽 실력있는 보석 세공사들이 좋은 마력 보석을 다 세공해도 그 정도: Even if all our best jewelers worked on the finest magic gems, they couldn't produce that much power...
strings.초인도 힘들다면 대체…. 후우…. 그런데 익시온이란 분은 지금 어디 계시: If even an Champion couldn't do it, then who...? Sigh... Where is this Ixion now, anyway?
strings.몇백 년 전의 인물이라 아마 좋은 곳에 계시지 않을까요?: He lived several hundred years ago, so I imagine he's in a better place now.
strings.아…. 그러면 어쩔 수 없겠네요. 이리스를 믿고 기다리는 수밖에요. 그렇: Oh... Then there's nothing we can do. We'll just have to trust Iris and wait. It's not as if I can blame her for this.
strings.네, 맞아요. 그런데 %s 님, 혹시 아주 잠깐이라도 기억을 잃은 적이: Yes, exactly. By the way, %s, have you ever lost your memory, even for a very short time?
strings.에? 아니요. 저는 그런 적이 한 번도 없는데…. 왜요?: Huh? No. That's never happened to me... Why?
strings.마력의 영향으로 일부 기억을 잃은 분을 봤었는데, %s 님의 표정이 가끔: I've seen someone who lost some of their memories because of magic. Sometimes your expression reminds me of theirs, %s. If I'm mistaken, I'm sorry.
strings.기분 탓일 거예요. 전 괜찮아요. 그러면 이세계의 공주님께도 그렇게 전할: You must be imagining it. I'm fine. I'll let the princess from the other world know what you said.
strings.오셨어요? 어떻게 하면 된다고 하던가요?: You're back! Did they say what we should do?
Oh, I see. The god you serve is in an unstable state.
strings.그래서 당분간은 이곳에 계셔야 할 것 같은데…, 괜찮으시겠어요?: So I think you'll have to stay here for a while... Will that be all right?
strings.네, 저는 괜찮아요. 언젠가는 돌아갈 수 있다는 확실한 답을 주셨으니 그: Yes, I'll be fine. You've assured me that I can return someday. That's enough for me.
The god you serve sounds like a very kind person.
strings.네, 그게 무슨 말씀이시죠? 이리스가요? 좋다고 해야 하는 걸까요? 흐음: Hm? What do you mean? Iris? Would 'kind' be the right word? Hmm...
strings.이리스, 참 아름다운 이름이에요. 후후. 그리고 말씀하셔도 아끼시는 게: Iris. What a beautiful name. Hehe. Whatever you say, I can tell how much you care about her.
I'm grateful to her for letting me meet someone as good as you...
strings.저는 앞으로 이곳을 돌보면서 인근 왕국이나 마을에 피해를 주지 않도록 할: From now on, I'll look after this place and make sure it causes no harm to the neighboring kingdoms or villages. I'll fulfill my responsibilities as a member of Ra's royal family to the very end.
All right. I'll come visit you from time to time, Tia.
Then travel safely. We'll meet again.
strings.(티야가 %s의 모습이 사라질 때까지 뒷모습을 지켜보며 배웅한다.): (Tia sees %s off, watching until they disappear from sight.)
strings.이 세계에도 죽은 자들의 신과 같은 존재가 있는 걸까? 그런 짓을 할 수: Could there be a being like the god of the dead in this world, too? One that has no choice but to do such things...?
strings.공주님께서 촉이 좋군. 죽음 어쩌고 하는 신은 아니지만, 조금은 비슷할지: You have good instincts, princess. I'm not a god of death or anything, but perhaps there's a bit of a resemblance.
strings.잠깐, 당신…. 어디서 나타난 건가요…?: Wait, you... Where did you come from...?
Hey, princess? No need to tremble or be afraid. I'm not going to hurt you.
There's simply something I'd like to ask.
strings.혹시 '▒▒▒▒'에 대해서 알고 있어?: Do you happen to know anything about '▒▒▒▒'?
